summary: V3-03 repair accepted: all four audited must-fix findings are resolved. (1) Composite cursor (occurredAt + id, ORDER BY occurredAt DESC, id DESC, predicate (occurredAt < c.o OR (occurredAt = c.o AND id < c.i))) implemented in InMemory and SQLite repositories for contributions, expenses and settlements, plus in paginateActivityLog; new test seeds PAGE_SIZE+5 entries with one identical occurredAt plus older entries and asserts every seeded id is reachable exactly once (independent 50-trial fuzz of both algorithms confirms no missing/duplicate ids). (2) loadHistory guarded by an in-flight ref that skips concurrent load-more calls and the append step dedupes by entry id; concurrent load-more test asserts no duplicate ids. (3) Share message and history row display use the entry's stored unit (e.unit) instead of the current household unit, preserving historical unit labels after a Minutes<->Points switch. (4) Custom-split submit is blocked when sum(customShares) != amountMinor: button disabled via memoized validation and submitExpense early-returns, so an invalid custom-split expense can never be persisted. Trusted verification exit 0: typecheck, 138 tests green, Expo export Android, prebuild, native debug build BUILD SUCCESSFUL. No V3-01/V3-02 regression; no chrono/premium/paywall reintroduced; cost gates green.
